items.prompt:
'The trail through the woods was bumpy, with many roots and rocks sticking out of the ground.'
The underlined word is 'bumpy.' What does it mean?
A) smooth and flat
B) uneven and rough

steps: Clue: 'roots and rocks sticking out of the ground.'
Roots and rocks sticking out create an uneven, rough surface.
'Bumpy' means uneven and rough — the opposite of smooth.

items.prompt:
'She was hesitant to try the new food because she had never seen it before.'
The underlined word is 'hesitant.' What does it mean?
A) eager and excited to try
B) unsure and slow to decide
items.answer: B) unsure and slow to decide

steps: Clue: 'she had never seen it before' — something unfamiliar often makes people cautious.
Being hesitant means pausing because you are unsure.
'Hesitant' means unsure and slow to decide.

items.prompt:
'The old bridge looked fragile — I was afraid it might break if too many people walked on it.'
The underlined word is 'fragile.' What does it mean?
A) very strong and sturdy
B) easily broken or damaged

steps: Clue: 'afraid it might break' — if something might break easily, it is fragile.
'Fragile' means easily broken or damaged.

items.prompt:
'The detective examined the clues very carefully before deciding what happened.'
The underlined word is 'examined.' What does it mean?
A) ignored and threw away
B) looked at closely and carefully
items.answer: B) looked at closely and carefully

steps: Clue: 'very carefully before deciding' — careful looking before making a decision.
Detectives look at clues closely to gather information.
'Examined' means looked at closely and carefully.

items.prompt:
'The storm made the sky dark and the wind howl — it was a dreadful evening.'
The underlined word is 'dreadful.' What does it mean?
A) wonderful and pleasant
B) terrible and frightening

steps: Clue: 'dark sky' and 'wind howl' — these are frightening weather conditions.
The description creates a scary, unpleasant picture.
'Dreadful' means terrible and frightening.

items.prompt:
'He was confident as he walked onto the stage — he had practiced his speech many times and was ready.'
The underlined word is 'confident.' What does it mean?
A) sure of himself and ready
B) nervous and unsure
items.answer: A) sure of himself and ready

steps: Clue: 'practiced his speech many times and was ready.'
Practicing and being ready leads to feeling sure of yourself.
'Confident' means sure of yourself and ready.

items.prompt:
'The garden was vibrant after the rain — flowers of every color bloomed everywhere.'
The underlined word is 'vibrant.' What does it mean?
A) dull and faded
B) bright and full of life
items.answer: B) bright and full of life

steps: Clue: 'flowers of every color bloomed everywhere' — colorful, blooming flowers suggest brightness and life.
'Vibrant' means bright and full of life.

items.prompt:
'The classroom was chaotic — everyone was talking at once and papers were flying everywhere.'
The underlined word is 'chaotic.' What does it mean?
A) calm and quiet
B) very disorganized and out of control
items.answer: B) very disorganized and out of control

steps: Clue: 'everyone talking at once' and 'papers flying everywhere.'
These are signs of disorder and confusion.
'Chaotic' means very disorganized and out of control.

items.prompt:
'The prefix 're-' means again. What does the word 'reread' mean?'
A) to read for the first time
B) to read again

steps: Break the word: 're-' + 'read.'
The prefix 're-' means again.
'Reread' means to read again.

items.prompt:
'The suffix '-ful' means full of. What does the word 'joyful' mean?'
A) without joy
B) full of joy

steps: Break the word: 'joy' + '-ful.'
The suffix '-ful' means full of.
'Joyful' means full of joy.

items.prompt:
'The prefix 'un-' means not. What does the word 'unclean' mean?'
A) very clean
B) not clean; dirty

steps: Break the word: 'un-' + 'clean.'
The prefix 'un-' means not.
'Unclean' means not clean.

items.prompt:
'The suffix '-less' means without. What does the word 'cloudless' mean?'
A) full of clouds
B) without clouds; clear sky

steps: Break the word: 'cloud' + '-less.'
The suffix '-less' means without.
'Cloudless' means without clouds.

items.prompt:
'She was so exhausted after the long hike that she fell asleep as soon as she sat down.'
The underlined word is 'exhausted.' What does it mean?
A) very energetic
B) very tired

steps: Clue: 'fell asleep as soon as she sat down' — falling asleep immediately is a sign of extreme tiredness.
'Exhausted' means very tired.

items.prompt:
'The prefix 're-' means again. What does the word 'rebuild' mean?'
A) to build again
B) to never build

steps: Break the word: 're-' + 'build.'
The prefix 're-' means again.
'Rebuild' means to build again.

items.prompt:
'The kitten peeked out from under the couch — only its tiny head was visible.'
The underlined word is 'visible.' What does it mean?
A) able to be seen
B) impossible to find

steps: Clue: 'only its tiny head was visible' — the head could be seen; the rest was hidden.
'Visible' means able to be seen.
